entities.summary: Abdullah I, a notable figure in the history of Jordan, associated with Emirate and Kingdom of Jordan (1921–1946). Preceded by Winston Church and Winston Churchill establishes the Emirate of Transjordan under Abdullah I. Their legacy influenced Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan gains full independence and King Abdullah I assassinated at Al-Aqsa Mosque.
